title: netcup-rs2000 bare-metal rebuild manifest
description: Inventory of the packages, users, repositories, units, config files and secret locations required to rebuild the Nishfleet control plane on a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 LTS box. This file intentionally never stores secret values — only paths and recovery steps. Data is assumed to come from the existing restic backup; this manifest is about the machine and the installable surface.

manual_tools.name: gh
manual_tools.note: GitHub CLI for `pi` issue workers. Download from https://github.com/cli/cli/releases and place at ~/.local/bin/gh, then `gh auth login` with the worker token path.

manual_tools.name: node
manual_tools.note: Node.js 22 LTS for pi, command-code and other agent harnesses. Install via NodeSource or the official tarball into ~/.local/bin and ~/.local/lib/node_modules.

manual_tools.name: npm
manual_tools.note: Ships with the Node.js install; used to install pi and command-code under ~/.local/lib/node_modules.

manual_tools.name: bun
manual_tools.note: Download the single binary from https://bun.sh/ to ~/.local/bin/bun.

manual_tools.name: claude
manual_tools.note: Anthropic Claude Code CLI. Follow vendor install instructions; the live path is /usr/bin/claude, which is outside the restic /home/nish backup.

manual_tools.name: codex
manual_tools.note: OpenAI Codex CLI. Install via pip or vendor instructions into ~/.local/bin/codex.

manual_tools.name: cursor
manual_tools.note: Cursor editor/agent CLI wrapper. The live path is a shell script in ~/.local/bin/cursor that points to ~/.local/share/cursor-agent.

manual_tools.name: pi
manual_tools.note: Nishfleet worker harness. Install the @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent npm package under ~/.local/lib/node_modules and symlink ~/.local/bin/pi.

manual_tools.name: command-code
manual_tools.note: Command Code CLI. Install the command-code npm package under ~/.local/lib/node_modules and symlink ~/.local/bin/command-code.

manual_tools.name: coderabbit
manual_tools.note: CodeRabbit CLI. Download the release binary to ~/.local/bin/coderabbit.

install_manifest.description: One line per file: <repo-relative-src> <absolute-dest>. install.sh symlinks user-scope entries and sudo-copies system-scope entries. The manifest is the allowlist of what the repo installs.

system_units.description: System-scope units that live outside the fleet-ops repo. Most are restored from restic or installed by the vendor packages (tailscale, prometheus, restic).

masked_units.description: System units that must be masked on this host because they can never reach a healthy state: the hardware they drive is absent (e.g. IPMI on a VPS) or networkd never finalizes their condition (e.g. systemd-networkd-wait-online). Masking at provision time stops the unit re-entering failed state and paging SystemUnitFailed every alert cycle. apply_rebuild masks each; live_check verifies each is masked so drift is caught. fleet-ops#2122, fleet-ops#3103.

units.name: openipmi.service
units.reason: netcup-rs2000 is a VPS with no IPMI BMC; the unit can never start and re-enters failed state, paging SystemUnitFailed every cycle.

units.name: systemd-networkd-wait-online.service
units.reason: On netcup-rs2000 the netplan-generated networkd config leaves eth0 Setup stuck in 'configuring' forever, so systemd-networkd-wait-online can never reach its online condition and exits 1 (Result=exit-code, failed) even though the host is online (eth0 routable, default route present). The wait-online unit serves no purpose here and its repeated failure pages SystemUnitFailed every alert cycle (fleet-ops#3103).

env_files.description: Environment files referenced by units and scripts. Values are not stored here.

secrets_locations.description: Directories and files that hold credentials, tokens, keys and session material. These must be recovered from restic or re-provisioned; never stored in git.
